abstract: By controlling the scarcity of an offshore parallel currency, policymakers can manage capital flows and steer the exchange rate. This is an alternative policy to setting the rate of a Tobin tax. However, its fiscal implications are distinct, and this paper lays them out. Having a parallel currency creates both seigniorage and liquidity revenues. The two revenues have different sizes and different Laffer curves, both of which vary with the regime for the exchange rate, with liquidity policies, and with the size of the offshore market. Quantitatively, the fiscal footprint of offshore money management is small and the Laffer curve is flat, boosting the chances that it can be used independently of fiscal pressures.
abstract_zh: 通过控制离岸平行货币的稀缺性，政策制定者能够管理资本流动并引导汇率。这是设定托宾税率的一种替代政策。然而，其财政影响截然不同，本文对此进行了阐述。拥有平行货币会同时产生铸币税收入和流动性收入。这两种收入规模不同，拉弗曲线也各异，且均随汇率制度、流动性政策以及离岸市场规模的变化而变化。从数量上看，离岸货币管理的财政足迹较小，拉弗曲线较为平坦，这增加了其能够在不受财政压力影响的情况下独立使用的可能性。
title: The Fiscal Implications of Parallel Currencies

abstract: Subjective well-being rankings are widely used to target social protection programs, yet their ability to capture relative welfare and wealth remains debated. This study compares three commonly used subjective ranking methods: self-, peer-, and elite-based poverty rankings, against consumption- and wealth-based measures using a large household survey in Ethiopia, where about 20 households per village were ranked from most to least “needy” by themselves, their peers, and community leaders. We assess concordance between subjective and conventional welfare rankings and explore sources of divergence. Subjective rankings align more with relative wealth than consumption and with total rather than per capita welfare, suggesting they overlook household composition. Among the three subjective ranking methods, elite-based rankings best capture conventional measures, although overall concordance between subjective and welfare-based rankings remains weak. Subjective rankings also better reflect relative deprivation among households exposed to covariate shocks. A composite index combining all three modestly improves concordance with standard metrics. We find suggestive evidence that information asymmetry, favoritism, and welfare dynamics partly explain discrepancies between subjective rankings and conventional welfare measures. These findings offer important insights to improve targeting in data-scarce settings.
abstract_zh: 主观幸福感排名被广泛用于瞄准社会保护项目，但其捕捉相对福利与财富的能力仍存争议。本研究利用埃塞俄比亚一项大型家庭调查，比较了三种常用的主观排名方法：自我、同伴和精英为基础的贫困排名，并将其与基于消费和财富的测量指标进行对照。在该调查中，每个村庄约20户家庭由自身、同伴和社区领袖从“最贫困”到“最不贫困”进行排名。我们评估主观排名与传统福利排名之间的一致性，并探讨分歧来源。主观排名与相对财富的一致性高于与消费的一致性，且与总福利而非人均福利更为一致，表明其忽视了家庭构成。在三种主观排名方法中，精英为基础的排名最能捕捉传统测量指标，尽管主观排名与基于福利的排名之间总体一致性仍然较弱。主观排名也更好地反映了遭受共同冲击家庭的相对剥夺状况。将三种方法结合而成的综合指数适度提高了与标准指标的一致性。我们发现提示性证据表明，信息不对称、偏袒和福利动态部分解释了主观排名与传统福利测量之间的差异。这些发现为在数据稀缺环境中改进瞄准提供了重要启示。
title: Perceived need and measured well-being: How well do subjective rankings capture relative poverty?
title_zh: 感知需求与测量福祉：主观排名在多大程度上能反映相对贫困？

abstract: We study how Chinese macroeconomic surprises affect global financial markets. We exploit forecast errors around key data releases and changes in asset prices in a 60-minute window around those releases. A positive Industrial Production (IP) surprise leads to an immediate increase in Chinese and Asia-Pacific stock returns, global long-term yields, and commodity prices highly demanded by China. A complementary identification strategy, which builds on different time-zones, confirms positive spillovers to international equity markets, with stronger effects in emerging economies. Our results highlight the role of both Hedging Premia and Growth Expectations in driving asset price comovement.
abstract_zh: 我们研究中国宏观经济意外如何影响全球金融市场。我们利用关键数据发布前后的预测误差以及这些发布前后60分钟窗口内的资产价格变化。正向的工业增加值（IP）意外会导致中国及亚太地区股票收益率、全球长期收益率，以及中国高需求商品价格立即上升。一种基于不同时区的互补识别策略，证实了对国际股票市场的正向溢出效应，且在新兴经济体中影响更强。我们的结果凸显了对冲溢价和增长预期在驱动资产价格联动中的作用。

title: Global financial spillovers of Chinese macroeconomic surprises
title_zh: 中国宏观经济意外的全球金融溢出效应
